verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an AI coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only single-task headless runs (`byteask exec` runs one task and exits), messaging one running session, and an /agents view that groups sessions. None of these is a documented capability to apply one operation across many items at once; scripting a loop around `exec` would be a user-side workaround, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
